detail_ok: Everything is fine; there is nothing to do.
detail_vpn_down: Re-Link starts watching on its own once FortiClient connects.
detail_stuck: The browser is using connections that should go through the VPN over the normal internet; pages may return 403/400. What to do is listed below, per browser.
detail_missing: These addresses have a new IP and no VPN connection yet. Disconnect and reconnect the VPN; Re-Link then cleans up the browser.
help_lead: It notices browser connections that get stuck while the VPN is on and fixes them without closing your tabs.
help_fix: Fix now refreshes the browser connections; your tabs stay open.
help_notify: It notifies you when something is stuck, or fixes it without asking when automatic fix is on.
help_tray: The tray icon shows the state
tray_missing: An address is outside the VPN
manual_tip: To fix it by hand: in Chrome/Edge press Shift+Esc → Network Service → End process. In Firefox, if the problem persists, close and reopen the browser.
connections_hint: Open connections of your browsers and where they go today. Turn on technical details for addresses and routes.
missing_note: The IP changed; reconnect the VPN.
hosts_hint: Company addresses from your bookmarks and settings. An address seen on the VPN counts as a VPN address for 7 days.
auto_fix_desc: Refresh the browser connections without asking when a stuck connection is found.
startup_desc: Starts quietly in the tray when you sign in.
interval_desc: How often the network is checked while the VPN is up. With no VPN, or while the connections are getting ready, Re-Link looks every second.
use_bookmarks_desc: Watch company addresses from your browser bookmarks (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Firefox…). The domains that count are edited below.
advanced_desc: Browsers and the VPN adapter are edited in the settings file; saving applies them at once.
ev_config_error: Settings file could not be read: {{error}}
notify_stuck_body: {{processes}} is using a connection that should go through the VPN over the normal internet. Click this notification to fix it; your tabs stay open.
notify_fixed_body: The connections were refreshed and your tabs are still open. Reload the stuck page (F5).
notify_missing_body: {{hosts}} no longer goes through the VPN (its IP address changed). Disconnect and reconnect the VPN; Re-Link then cleans up the browser.
notify_sockets_body: The stuck connections were closed. Reload the stuck page (F5).
ev_route_failed: Could not add a VPN route for {{host}}: {{error}}
notify_route_body: {{hosts}} goes through the VPN again. You don't need to reconnect.
helper_on: Installed: missing VPN connections are added automatically and stuck connections are closed one by one (Firefox too).
helper_off: Not installed. Without it a changed IP address needs a VPN reconnect. Install: sudo ./install-linux.sh
activity_hint: History is kept across restarts. The latest {{max}} events show here; the log file has them all.
detail_settling: FortiClient is still setting up its connections. Re-Link checks again in a few seconds; nothing to do.
ev_no_network_process: {{process}} keeps the connection in its main process; Re-Link cannot close it without administrator rights. Restart the browser to clear the stuck page
notify_stuck_firefox_body: {{processes}} is using a connection it opened while the VPN was off. It usually clears by itself within minutes; restart Firefox if you don't want to wait.
stuck_note_fixable: Fix now refreshes the connections; your tabs stay open.
stuck_note_firefox: Firefox keeps this connection in its main process; Re-Link cannot close it. It closes by itself after a few idle minutes; restart Firefox if you don't want to wait.
notifications_desc: Which events show a notification. Problems only: stuck connections and addresses outside the VPN.
welcome_body: Re-Link notices browser connections that get stuck while the VPN is on and fixes them without closing your tabs.
welcome_tray: If you close it, Re-Link keeps running in the tray; open it again from its icon.
tray_notice_title: Re-Link is running in the tray
tray_notice_body: The window is closed but monitoring continues. Open it or quit from the tray icon.
why_vpn: All of this host's addresses go through the VPN.
why_missing: This host should use the VPN but {{count}} of its addresses leave over the home network. FortiClient has not added the route yet; it should fix itself, otherwise reconnect the VPN.
why_internet: There is no VPN route for this host; it goes over the normal internet.
why_no_vpn: The VPN is not connected, so the host cannot be judged yet.
why_unresolved: The host's name did not resolve (DNS did not answer or there is no record).
update_available_body: You can install it from the Settings page.
update_banner: A new version is available: {{version}} (you have {{current}}).
check_updates_desc: Tells you when a newer release appears on GitHub. You decide when to install it.
update_failed: The update could not be installed: {{error}}
theme_desc: Light or dark. System follows the operating system.
close_to_tray: Keep running in the tray when closed
close_to_tray_desc: Closing the window leaves Re-Link watching from the tray. Off: closing the window quits Re-Link.
start_hidden_desc: When it starts with the session, it stays in the tray instead of opening the window.
zoom_desc: Makes everything in the window larger or smaller. Ctrl + and Ctrl - work too.
